report_paragraphs: Plexus Medical Accuracy & Answer-Uniqueness Audit — All 120 Rows

All 120 rows read and individually reviewed: 60 Split (SPL-001–060), 30 Sequence (SEQ-001–030), 30 Missing Step (MIS-001–030). Each tile, group assignment, ordered step, answer choice, distractor, overall explanation, and component explanation was checked against its stated clinical_context. Subtle endocrine/biochemistry/renal claims were verified against current specialty literature (e.g., 17-OHD per Willemsen et al., JCEM 2025 and El-Maouche et al., Lancet 2017; 21-OHD per Speiser & White, NEJM 2003 and Merke & Auchus, NEJM 2020; Gilbert per Erlinger et al., Gastroenterology 2014; PTH-RANKL per Estell & Rosen, Nat Rev Endocrinol 2021; FHH per Arnold et al., Nat Rev Endocrinol 2021; DI per Garrahy et al., Clin Endocrinol 2019).

Result: 120 PASS, 0 REVISE, 0 EXCLUDE, 0 UNCERTAIN. No answer keys, groupings, chains, blanks, or distractors required correction. The draft author's source_caveat corrections of PDF errors were independently confirmed as justified. reviewer_corrected_answer = "original answer confirmed" for all rows; review_status = AI_REVIEWED_PASS for all rows. No row is labeled human-verified.

For every Missing Step, the displayed blank matches the intended position, exactly one choice completes the chain, and all three distractors are wrong for that position/context. Consistency with the paired Sequence round (same concept_id) confirmed.
None. All 120 content IDs were reviewed; none remain pending.

import_contract.schema_role: Interchange format. Inspect and map to the existing application content schema before importing.
player_visible_before_answer: shuffled tiles for split or sequence
display_chain and shuffled choices for missing_step
import_contract.answer_material: Answer keys, correct answers, ordered steps, component explanations and source/reviewer caveats are answer material; do not show them before a response.
import_contract.clinical_context: Essential qualifiers are in clinical_context and must be available to the player before answering. Do not silently omit them when adapting the schema.
import_contract.identifiers: Preserve content_id for each playable variant and concept_id for linked chain variants.
import_contract.split_answer_key: Object mapping stable tile IDs to group A or B. The group labels are group_a and group_b.
import_contract.sequence_answer_key: Array of stable tile IDs in the correct order. ordered_steps contains the corresponding text.
import_contract.missing_answer_key: Object with a 1-based missing position, stable correct choice ID and correct text. Shuffle choices without breaking the ID mapping.
import_contract.chain_pairing: Sequence and Missing Step items share the same concept_id and ordered_steps. They are two formats of one chain, not independent chain concepts.
import_contract.audit_answer_summaries: review_evidence.reported_answer_summary preserves the report abbreviated wording for traceability. It is not a replacement for the full canonical correct_answer.
import_contract.review_status: AI_REVIEWED_PASS records the supplied AI audit result; it is not human verification.
import_contract.inactive_fields: Fields irrelevant to an item format are null.
